      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/halfling-ruins/objects.lua",
      "source": "A beautifully soft robe of fine white fur. It looks designed for a halfling noble, with glorious sapphires sewn across the hems. But entrancing as it is, you can't help but feel a little queasy wearing it.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "一件由上等白色毛皮制成的长袍，柔软而美丽。它看起来是为半身人贵族设计的，衣边缀满了华美的蓝宝石。尽管它是如此迷人，穿上它时你却忍不住有些恶心。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0145 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/heart-gloom/npcs.lua",
      "source": "This strange globe of blue light seems to be alive and asleep. Nothing about it moves, yet you can feel the crushing power of its dreams assaulting your mind.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "这个奇怪的蓝色光球似乎是活的，而且正在熟睡。它纹丝不动，你却能感受到它梦境中那股压倒性的力量正冲击着你的精神。"
    },
    {

      "source": "An invocation portal, perpetually summoning beings through it.",

      "special": null,
      "target": "一个召唤传送门，不断地从中召唤出生物。"
    },
    {

      "entry_id": "2cd7dd508ffa9410836f580e2f581db09c7172fae82fb30642a006dfba6d7d38",

      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/high-peak/npcs.lua",
      "source": "A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "一个生物站在你面前，它有着长长的、类似触须的附肢，头部的位置只有一个矮墩墩的突起。一股强烈的力量从它身上散发出来，与你以往感受过的任何力量都截然不同。它只可能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！"
